feat(gate): validate operand length and emptiness; add demo tasks script

- gate/decide.mjs: export validateOperand() that rejects empty or >2000-char
  operand values; call it at the top of decide() before any authority check
- gate/decide.test.mjs: add 14 unit tests covering validateOperand directly
  and decide() integration for each tool (run_command, add_dependency,
  git_commit_push, edit_protected_file) with empty and oversized operands
- scripts/bob-build-tasks.sh: switch to --format stream-json with separate
  stdout/stderr log files; close stdin with </dev/null to prevent hangs;
  make B1 skippable via START env var; add em-dash review note to B4 prompt
- scripts/bob-demo-tasks.sh: new script that drives end-to-end Gated Agent
  demo sessions (D1-D7) against sample-project with per-run intent injection
  and decision log capture
